title: Quantization as an Accidental Jailbreak: Robustness vs Bit-Width

original_idea.body: Evaluate one open instruct model at fp16/int8/int4 for refusal robustness (StrongREJECT, prefill) and capability to test whether quantization preferentially erodes shallow first-token alignment.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Real deployment risk but jailbreak-to-catastrophic-risk chain indirect; gap (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Standard quantization tooling + public benchmarks on one open model; beginner-accessible (level 5).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear deliverable (safety vs capability vs bit-width) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Consumer quantization is lab-deprioritized; neglected open-weight deployment-safety work (level 5).

low_compute.reasoning: Quantized inference is consumer-GPU friendly; light compute.

novelty.reasoning: Quantization-vs-safety degradation has been studied; largely addressed.
